purpose: Remove the compatibility Bridge from known-employee canary login preflight after all five employees are Native-ready and all business reads are native.
invariants: Known employee canary login preflight uses Auth health only when bridge-free configuration is exact.
Bridge health is not fetched in bridge-free canary mode.
Native-ready count must be at least 5 or the canary fails closed.
Unknown employee usernames remain on the Legacy path.
Unsupported known-canary actions fail closed when frontend Bridge is disabled.
Backend Bridge remains enabled temporarily as rollback safety during the frontend-only Entry631 gate.
Accounting stays READONLY and EasyStore remains untouched.
